definitions.explanation: The mechanical barrier at a railroad crossing that lowers to block traffic when a train is approaching.

examples.japanese: {遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|お}りた。
{遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wait until the crossing gate goes up.

examples.japanese: {遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|お}りて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です。
examples.english: It's extremely dangerous to force your way across when the crossing gate is down.

notes:
USAGE:
{遮断機|しゃだんき} specifically refers to the barrier arm at a ⟦{踏切|ふみきり}→踏切：06493_fumikiri⟧ (railroad crossing). When the {遮断機|しゃだんき} comes down, it is accompanied by a ⟦{警報機|けいほうき}→警報機：16252_keihouki⟧ (warning bell/light).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|お}りる: the gate comes down
- {遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: the gate goes up
- {遮断機|しゃだんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる: to duck under the gate

FORMS:
⟦{遮断|しゃだん}→遮断：15673_shadan⟧ (interruption, blocking) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine).
